basics.name: Anshul Panigrahi
basics.label: AI engineer building LLM products and tool-using agents
basics.summary: Information Technology undergraduate at VIT who ships AI products end to end: on-device speech, LLM analytics that still work without the model, multi-agent support systems with human approval gates. Co-inventor on three published Indian patent applications. Looking for AI engineering internships with product teams shipping LLM features, agents and tool use.

work.name: Brandworks Technologies Private Limited
highlights: Engineered a nine-stage data-quality pipeline for 26,419 images across 8 fruit classes: label normalization, perceptual-hash leakage checks, annotation filtering and training-set balancing.
Trained YOLOv8s for 120 epochs; 80.4% precision and 66.2% mAP@50 on 4,728 holdout images; diagnosed domain-shift failures on a separate 155-image synthetic webcam stress set.

certificates.name: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure 2025 Certified AI Foundations Associate

publications.name: Medication dispenser with on-device user authentication and medication verification (IN202641027860 A1)
publications.summary: A pill dispenser that recognises the patient's face, releases only their dose, then checks the pill with an on-device classifier before it is taken. Nothing leaves the device.

publications.name: Cognitive load-aware distributed task scheduling using hardware-bound processing control and predictive task migration (IN202641088096 A1)
publications.summary: A scheduler that reads how hard you are concentrating from keyboard, mouse and app-switching patterns, then holds back, slows or moves disruptive work to other machines until you surface.

publications.name: Zero-trust physical enclave security using continuous biometric entropy and RF-based perimeter monitoring (IN202641067209 A1)
publications.summary: A workstation that stays unlocked only while a live pulse is present and no unknown radio is nearby. Lose either, and the session keys are destroyed on the spot.

projects.name: Eve — Windows Dictation
projects.description: Hold a hotkey, speak, and your words land wherever you were typing. A shipped desktop app with offline speech recognition, a live overlay, searchable history and CPU/GPU fallback.
highlights: Getting the model, the desktop runtime, session state and release packaging to behave as one product.

projects.name: Customer Support Agents
projects.description: A LangGraph system that classifies tickets, routes them to specialist agents, retrieves from a RAG store, remembers customers in SQLite and gates risky actions behind human approval.
highlights: A supervisor node checks every answer, and refunds or cancellations wait for a human.

projects.name: Stella — Health Analytics
projects.description: Health analytics over wearable exports: FastAPI, React + Vite, DuckDB, and an Ollama-backed LLM layer for chat and reports that degrades cleanly to metrics-only.
highlights: The LLM is a feature, not a dependency. The product still works when the model isn't there.

projects.name: Cognitive Load-Aware Scheduler
projects.description: Routes work using both machine state and a live Cognitive Load Score from typing variance, idle time and context switches, with flow-state protection and a baseline comparison.
highlights: Optimises the human + machine system, not just the infrastructure. Patented.

projects.name: Real-Time Predictive Maintenance
projects.description: Kafka, Spark, Cassandra, PyTorch and graph analytics across 5,000 simulated machines: streaming anomaly detection plus cascade-failure analysis and constrained mitigation.
highlights: Model output is wired into a live data path and downstream decisions, not left in a notebook.

projects.name: Physically-Bounded Mode Discovery
projects.description: HDBSCAN proposes operating regimes on NASA CMAPSS and CWRU while physics constraints reject implausible clusters.
highlights: A cluster isn't accepted because a metric likes it. It also has to make physical sense.

projects.name: Veri-Dose
projects.description: Medication verification with a quantized MobileNetV2 that knows when it's unsure: low-confidence predictions go to a human instead of pretending certainty.
highlights: Calibrated confidence and a fallback path, built into the product. Patent IN202641027860 A1.

projects.name: SecureTorrent
projects.description: Malware-aware torrent security: YARA rules, a hybrid ML detector, qBittorrent integration and an API test suite.
highlights: Signatures catch the known threats and the model covers the rest.
